theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Build Your Dreams With Structured Goal-Based Investing
body: Align your investments with life milestones. Start early, invest regularly, stay consistent toward each goal.
caption: Every major life goal deserves a dedicated investment strategy. Whether education, retirement, home, or wedding—structured planning helps you reach milestones systematically. #GoalBasedInvesting #StructuredWealth #LifeMilestones #InvestmentStrategy #WealthBuilding
